1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 1 m de longitud, con la parte frontal alta y redondeada, cuerpo comprimido, aleta caudal surcada y cabeza con cresta, y una coloración vistosa que oscila entre los tonos azul, amarillo, blanco y verde; es comestible. (Coryphaenidae, Coryphaena hippurus).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 1 m in length, with a high and rounded forehead, compressed body, notched caudal fin, and head with crest, and vibrant coloration ranging from blue, yellow, white, and green tones; it is edible (Coryphaenidae, Coryphaena hippurus).
